name: agent-instructions
description: Maintain project AGENTS.md guidance and find or apply selected refactoring changes in AI agent instructions.

interface.longDescription:
Keep AI agent instructions clear, useful and current.

Maintain recurring AGENTS.md reviews, audit their schedules, and update project guidance from approved source tasks. Find refactoring opportunities in agent instructions, then apply only the changes you select in the same task.

Scheduled reviews can edit only the selected root AGENTS.md. Scheduling needs Codex desktop and accessible source tasks; manual refactoring needs access to the instruction files.
defaultPrompt: Audit all of my AGENTS.md review schedules and report any drift.
Add this project to recurring agent instruction improvements.
Find refactoring opportunities in this project's agent instructions.
